description: This file defines the CompassActivity class, which is an Android activity demonstrating a 3D compass using OpenGL ES and device sensors. It includes activity lifecycle management, sensor event handling, and OpenGL rendering code.

classes.name: CompassActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a 3D compass using OpenGL ES and device sensors.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes sensors and OpenGL surface view, sets renderer and layout.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers sensor listeners and resumes OpenGL rendering.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters sensor listeners and pauses OpenGL rendering.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Renders the 3D compass, applying sensor-based rotation matrices.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts viewport and projection matrix on surface size change.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL settings and loads the 3D model buffers.

methods.name: onAccuracyChanged
methods.description: Sensor accuracy change handler (empty in this case).

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Updates sensor data, computes orientation, and logs sensor info periodically.
